signInHeadline: Your songs, ready for the stage.
signInFeatureSheets: Chord sheets with diagrams, lyrics, strumming and real tab
signInFeatureJam: Jam rooms that keep the whole band on the same section
signInFeatureImport: Import from photos, PDFs, links and YouTube
missingKeys: Add Clerk and Convex keys to the environment before signing in.
newSongHint: Start with the basics. You can add sections, lyrics and tab next.
title: Title
duplicateSongHint: Open it, or add a new version to it.
importDuplicateHint: Add this import as a new version of it, or change the title or artist to keep it separate.
addedAsVersion: Added as a new version of {title}
noSongsHint: Write a song by hand or import a sheet you already have.
deleteSongHint: All versions of this song are deleted and removed from setlists. This cannot be undone.
deleteVersionHint: Its sections and parts are deleted and it is removed from setlists. This cannot be undone.
errorLastVersion: A song needs at least one version. Delete the song instead.
bpmHint: Beats per minute. Leave empty if you don't know.
tuningHint: Low to high, separated by spaces.
suggestedCapoHint: Players start with this capo. Everyone can still change it for themselves.
outOfRange: Some tab notes cannot move with this key.
notationHint: How chord names are written. The music stays the same.
emptySheet: This version has no sections yet.
strummingHint: D = down, U = up, x = muted, - = rest. For example D-DU-UDU.
readOnlyHint: You can read this version, but only its owner or band editors can change it.
versionDetailsHint: Key, tempo and tuning apply to every section.
performedByHint: For covers. Leave empty to use {artist}.
repeatedHint: Played {count} times. Changes apply everywhere it repeats.
removeRepeatHint: Only this occurrence is removed. The other repeats stay.
notesPlaceholder: Notes for this section, e.g. “quiet, palm muted”
addLyricsAndChordsHint: Song text with chords above the words
addTabHint: Riffs and solos on a 6-line staff
lyricsPlaceholder:
[D]Eines weiß ich genau, meine [G]Stadt liegt im Blau
Lines without chords are plain lyrics
lyricsHint: Put a chord in brackets right before the syllable where it changes. Paste a sheet with chords above the lyrics and it is converted for you.
previewEmpty: Start typing to see a preview.
tabHint: One line per string, high e on top. Use numbers for frets, h p b / for techniques and | between bars.
chordVoicingsHint: Only the diagram changes. The chart and everyone else's view stay the same.
noVoicings: No diagrams found for this chord.
newSetlistHint: Collect the songs for a gig and play them in order.
setlistsHint: Running orders for your gigs and rehearsals.
noSetlistsHint: Create one for your next gig and add songs from your library.
deleteSetlistHint: The songs stay in your library.
songPickerHint: Pick one or more songs. They are added to the end of the setlist.
emptySetlistHint: Add songs from your library to build the running order.
bandsHint: Share songs and setlists with the people you play with.
newBandHint: You become the owner and can invite members by email.
noBandsHint: Create a band to share songs and setlists with others.
noBandSongsHint: Songs created for this band show up here for every member.
editorRoleHint: Can create and edit band songs
viewerRoleHint: Can read and play band songs
inviteHint: They need to have signed in to Gigbook once.
jamHint: Play together. Everyone sees the same song and section as the host.
startJamHint: You become the host and pick the songs. Share the code with the others.
joinJamHint: Enter the 6-character code from the host.
jamPickSongHint: Choose a song below. Everyone in the room sees it right away.
jamWaitingHint: The song appears here as soon as the host picks one.
jamNoAccessHint: It belongs to someone else's library. Ask the host to share it with a band you are in.
personalVersionWarning: {name} is playing a different version than the room.
importHint: Turn pasted text, a ChordPro file, a photo, PDF, web page or video into an editable song.
pasteHint: Chords above the lyrics, ChordPro or ASCII tab all work.
pastePlaceholder:
D              G
Eines weiß ich genau, meine Stadt liegt im Blau
dropFileHint: A photo, a PDF, or a ChordPro or text file. On a phone you can take a picture.
unsupportedFile: Use an image, a PDF, or a ChordPro or text file.
textAnalysis: Recognized {sections} sections, {chords} chords and {tabs} tab bars.
textReadsFree: Imports instantly in your browser, without AI.
textWeakAi: No chords found, so AI will read this.
textWeakNoKey: No chords found. It will import as lyrics only.
useAiHint: Can help with messy layouts. Uses your AI key.
importPrivacyLocal: Read in your browser. Nothing is sent to an AI.
readWithoutAiHint: Check the sections and chords. If the layout was messy, let AI try.
urlHint: A page with chords or tab, e.g. from a chord site.
youtubeHint: Paste the link or the video id.
newSongFromImportHint: Create a new song from the import
importPrivacy: Your source is sent to {provider} with your own key.
noApiKey: This source needs an AI key
noApiKeyHint: AI reads photos, PDFs, web pages and videos with your own key. A Google Gemini key is free. Pasted text and ChordPro files work without one.
pasteRequired: That page could not be read. Paste the chart text instead.
importWorkingHint: This usually takes under a minute. You can leave this page and come back.
mapSectionHint: Choose where each imported section goes in the target version.
settingsHint: Preferences for this account on every device.
appearanceHint: Dark is easiest on the eyes on stage.
languageHint: Language of the app. Song text is never translated.
apiKeyHelp: Photos, PDFs, web pages and videos are read by AI with your own key. Keys are stored encrypted and used only for your imports.
replaceKeyPlaceholder: Paste a new key to replace it
deleteKeyHint: Imports with this provider stop working until you add a new key.
errorNoApiKey: Add an AI key in settings.
errorRateLimit: Too many imports in the last hour.
errorInvalidKey: The provider rejected this key. Check it in settings.
errorAiRateLimit: Your AI provider's limit is reached. Try again later or pick another model.
errorModelUnsupported: Your AI model can't read this kind of file. Pick another model in settings.
aiModelHint: Used for every AI import. Add a key to unlock its models.
providerGoogleHint: Free: create a key in Google AI Studio, no billing account needed. The free tier allows a limited number of imports per day.
providerOpenaiHint: Paid per use. Create a key at platform.openai.com.
providerAnthropicHint: Paid per use. Create a key in the Anthropic Console.
errorImportFailed: The model could not read that source.
errorUserNotFound: No account with that email has opened the app yet.
